title: Talent Acquisition Specialist II
description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist II
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

**Job responsibilities**  

* In conjunction with all of Talent Acquisition, creates a deep and diverse talent pool to service resourcing requirements across multiple business units.
* Collaborates directly with hiring managers to understand business and skill set requirements to build a comprehensive strategic hiring plan by setting the vision, strategy, and goals to ensure current and future resource demands are met.
* As a strategic partner to your hiring managers, provide expertise in market insights, talent landscape, and an understanding of talent needs to establish expectations and build a collaborative approach with your customers to meet demands.
* Ensure customer satisfaction by providing regular updates to hiring managers and setting expectations on the hiring process per requisition or department, or both, as required.
* Utilize appropriate sourcing channels (including applicant tracking system, candidate relationship management system, job boards, advertising, networking, employee referral program) to identify qualified candidates.
* Monitor recruitment sourcing methods and provide recommendations to improve applicant attraction. Suggests innovative solutions to sourcing challenges and competitive intelligence from those efforts.
* Offers creative solutions to sourcing hard to fill requisitions in collaboration with the business.
* Responsible to manage full cycle recruiting process to include but not limited to: complete initial screening interview of potential candidates and reject non\-relevant applications, prepare candidate profile for hiring manager following interview screen, submit short listed candidates to hiring managers for review, conducts candidate debrief session after interviews are completed and extends verbal offers of employment to successful candidates.
* Ensures data accuracy within Applicant Tracking System.
* Initiates and maintains open communication with hiring managers and Human Resources (HR) colleagues in meeting recruiting needs.
* May create collateral HR materials for trade shows, professional organization meetings, and career fairs. May attend trade shows, professional organization meetings and career fairs.
* May provide training and coaching activities for Talent Acquisition Specialists.
* Performs other job\-related duties as assigned
**Qualifications \- External**

**What we’re looking for**  

Basic Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
* Experience as a Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter in a corporate or agency environment
* Proven track record in direct sourcing and managing an end\-to\-end recruiting process required
* Demonstrated leadership skills
* Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to think and influence strategically
* Proven track record in utilizing creative recruitment techniques and measurement of results
* Ability to work well with multi\-functional team and with all levels within organization
* Strong problem solving, influencing, negotiating, facilitating and partnership skills required
* Ability to effectively engage and build relationships with line management, employees, and HR team at all levels
* Excellent organizational skills and ability to effectively manage multiple demands without missing deadlines
* Strong time management skills and able to work independently
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Strong customer services skills
* Strong attention to detail and an ability to maintain confidentiality
Preferred Qualifications
  

* Experience as a full cycle Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter supporting a CRO or in the Pharmaceutical industry
* Experience working in Workday
* Experience with a CRM
**Get to know Syneos Health**

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.  

  



http://www.syneoshealth.com


**Additional Information**

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

title: AI / ML Internship at Hyderabad
description:
Development Department
Hyderabad • India •
**Overview**
------------


This is a hands\-on, project\-driven internship where you will work directly alongside our ML/AI Engineers and AI Agent Engineers. You will contribute to real deliverables, not just observe, spanning computer vision, multimodal learning, agentic systems, and RAG pipelines.The track you work on is flexible and will be matched to your interests, background, and the team's current priorities. We believe great interns come from many different starting points, curiosity, logical thinking, and a willingness to learn matter more than a perfect resume.By the end of 6 months, you will have worked on production\-adjacent AI systems and built a portfolio of meaningful, demonstrable work


**Skills**
----------

  

  

**Basic Technical Skills (Good to Have, Not All Required)**

* Python basics — ability to write scripts, run notebooks, and understand existing code.
* Familiarity with any ML/DL concept — even from coursework or self\-study counts.
* Exposure to tools like Jupyter, Google Colab, HuggingFace, or OpenAI API.
* Basic understanding of NLP, computer vision, or LLMs — at any depth.
* Comfortable using Git for version control.

**What You Will Work On**


Depending on your track, your day\-to\-day work may include contributions across any of the following areas:

**Vision Track**

* Assist with dataset collection, labeling, and augmentation
* Run and evaluate pre\-trained models (YOLO, ResNet, SAM, CLIP)
* Support model fine\-tuning and performance benchmarking
* Document experiments and results clearly

**Agents Track**

* Write, test, and refine prompts for agent workflows
* Help build and test tool\-calling integrations
* Research and benchmark agent frameworks and orchestrators
* Assist in deploying agents to GPT Store or Copilot Studio

**Multimodal (MLM) Track**

* Explore and test vision\-language models


(LLaVA, BLIP\-2\)

* Prepare multimodal datasets and evaluation sets
* Run inference pipelines and document outputs

**RAG \& Knowledge Track**

* Support document ingestion, chunking, and embedding pipelines
* Test retrieval quality across different vector stores
* Experiment with chunking strategies and re\-ranking methods
* Compare model performance across tasks (VQA, captioning)
* Help evaluate RAG pipeline accuracy and relevance

**Cross\-Track Responsibilities**


Regardless of track, all interns will contribute to:

* Research \& Benchmarking — survey latest models, tools, and papers summarize findings for the team.
* Prompt Writing \& Testing — write, iterate, and evaluate prompts across different LLMs and tasks.
* Model Evaluation \& Testing — run structured evaluations, log results, and identify failure patterns.
* Data Work — collection, cleaning, annotation, and quality checks as needed by the team.
* Documentation — write clear technical notes, how\-to guides, and experiment logs.
* Team Collaboration — participate in standups, sprint planning, and design reviews.

**Who We Are Looking For**

**Education**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Electronics, Mathematics, or a related field.
* Final\-year students and fresh graduates are welcome to apply.

 **What Matters Most**

* Curiosity — genuine interest in AI and willingness to go deep on problems.
* Logical thinking — ability to break down a problem and think through it step by step.
* Communication — can clearly explain what you tried, what worked, and what did not.
* Initiative — proactively looks for ways to contribute rather than waiting to be told.
* Coachability — open to feedback and fast to apply it.

 **What You Will Gain**

* Real\-world experience building and shipping AI systems — not just toy projects.
* Mentorship from ML/AI Engineers actively working on vision, agents, and multimodal systems.
* A strong portfolio of demonstrable work to show in future job applications.
* Exposure to the full AI product lifecycle — from idea to deployment.
* Certificate of completion and a performance\-based letter of recommendation.
* Potential for a full\-time offer based on performance during the internship.

### **How to Apply**

* Send your resume to: **careers@smartinfologiks.com**
* For queries, call: **\+91\-8080727912**

https://www.thenudge.org/ is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals and youth on rural development, agriculture, skilling and economic inclusion, along with 15\+ central and state government partners.

https://www.thenudge.org/people\-and\-partners/ support from 90\+ eminent philanthropists , 40\+ corporates and 15\+ foundations including Gates, Mackenzie Scott, Vinod Khosla, Nandan Nilekani, Tata Trusts, Skoll, Meta, LinkedIn, HDFC, Mphasis, KPMG and L'Oreal, we are contributing towards a "poverty\-free India, within our lifetime".

* Excellent communication, influencing, and conflict resolution skills.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with ability to apply data and insights for decision\-making.
* Ability to independently manage projects from planning to execution.
* Deep commitment to diversity, inclusion, and people\-centric practices.

 **What’s in it for you?** **Own your growth:** Our impact\-led environment encourages learning and development through L\&D wallet, mentorships, and opportunities to grow into new roles.**Find your tribe:** We hire for intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order. You will join a passionate team committed to people excellence and inclusion.**Take big bets:** Be part of scalable and impactful initiatives — driving change across 50,000\+ households, 15\+ governments, 200\+ social enterprises and more.**Make it happen:** Work with high autonomy and purpose in a culture that empowers Nudgesters to take action, iterate fast and implement bold ideas. *We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organisation and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

title: HR Management Trainee
description:
**Job Title:** HR Executive **Company:** Anuj IMF Pvt. Ltd. **Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Work from Office **Experience:** 1–4 Years **Work Schedule:** 6 Days a Week \| Monday to Saturday **Working Hours:** 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM **Office Address:** A 27D, Sector 16, Top Floor, Noida

**About the Company**

Anuj IMF Pvt. Ltd. is a complete financial services company offering a wide range of products and solutions including Insurance, Mutual Funds, Loans, Investment Advisory, Tax Planning, and Wealth Management. We are a fast\-growing firm with a customer\-first approach, helping individuals and businesses achieve their financial goals.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented HR Executive to join our team at our Noida office. You will be responsible for end\-to\-end hiring across departments — from sourcing and screening to onboarding. This is a full\-time, work\-from\-office role based at A 27D, Sector 16, Top Floor, Noida. The role involves active candidate engagement over calls using CRM tools, sharing opportunities via WhatsApp and Email, and conducting virtual presentations over Zoom or Microsoft Teams. Working days are Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle complete recruitment cycle — job posting, screening, interviewing, offer rollout, and onboarding
* Actively reach out to prospective candidates over calls using CRM software to track and manage leads
* Maintain accurate candidate records, follow\-up schedules, and communication history in the CRM system
* Share job details, company profiles, and role\-specific information with candidates over WhatsApp and Email in a professional manner
* Conduct virtual career presentations and company introduction sessions over Zoom or Microsoft Teams for prospective candidates and fresh applicants
* Source candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed), social media, referrals, and campus drives
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates based on job requirements
* Schedule and conduct telephonic, video, and face\-to\-face interviews
* Coordinate with department heads to understand hiring needs and prepare accurate job descriptions
* Manage salary negotiations and offer letters in line with company policy
* Conduct background verification and manage pre\-joining documentation
* Maintain recruitment MIS reports and track hiring metrics
* Support induction and onboarding programs for new joiners
* Organize walk\-in drives and participate in job fairs
* Contribute to employer branding activities on LinkedIn and other platforms

* Manages a pay plan by conducting periodic pay surveys; scheduling and conducting job evaluations; preparing pay budgets; monitoring and scheduling individual pay actions; and recommending, planning, and implementing pay structure revisions.

* Implements employee benefits programs and informs employees of benefits by studying and assessing benefit needs and trends; recommending benefit programs to management; directing the processing of benefit claims; obtaining and evaluating benefit contract bids; awarding benefit contracts; and designing and conducting educational programs on benefit programs.
* Ensures legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable human resource federal and state requirements, conducting investigations, maintaining records, and representing the organization at hearings.

title: Director, Data Strategy & Engineering (India Team)
description:
Portage Point Partners is a Chicago headquartered, middle market focused advisory, interim management and investment banking firm with a national footprint across ten US offices. It delivers deeply integrated, cross functional solutions across Transaction Advisory, Valuations, Investment Banking, Turnaround \& Restructuring, Performance Improvement, Transaction Execution Services and Office of the CFO services. Backed by 160\+ experts with blue\-chip consulting, finance, operations and investing backgrounds, the firm brings a uniquely holistic perspective to complex financial and operational situations.

The firm is known for its high impact, high pace execution model and has grown rapidly since inception in 2016\.

The Director, Data Strategy \& Engineering role at Portage Point represents a unique opportunity to define and execute the firm’s data platform vision for the India delivery organization. This Director will own the strategic direction of all data assets, architecture, governance and capability building that underpin the firm’s AI product portfolio and consulting analytics services, spanning high\-value use cases including commercial and financial due diligence (CDD/FDD), value creation tracking, working capital optimization, restructuring scenario analysis, portfolio company performance benchmarking and management information system (MIS) intelligence layers. Reporting to the India Delivery Leader as a peer to the Director, AI Solutions, and partnering closely with US\-based Practice Line Leaders, this Director will lead a team of two to three Vice Presidents and their Senior Associates (approximately 15 to 20 professionals) across data engineering, analytics engineering and data governance, owning hiring, vendor partner management and capability development across the function. This person will operate as a true data executive within the India capability centre — influencing how data is collected, structured, governed and commercialized across the firm’s global consulting practice, and representing the firm externally as a subject matter expert on data strategy in deal advisory and portfolio management. If you are a senior data leader with deep technical depth and a consulting or professional services background who wants to define how data and AI transform a high\-growth advisory firm, this is the right role for you.



### **Responsibilities**

* Define and own the firm’s data platform strategy for the India delivery organization, spanning cloud data architecture, AI data infrastructure, master data management and the analytics capability roadmap
* Drive architectural decisions for the firm’s data ecosystem including data lakehouse design (bronze/silver/gold medallion architecture), real\-time versus batch processing trade\-offs, semantic layer strategy, data mesh adoption and AI\-ready data product frameworks
* Own the data architecture review function, ensuring all new AI products and data pipelines meet architectural, security and governance standards before development commences
* Execute the data strategy that enables the AI Solutions product roadmap, defining how data is structured, labeled, versioned and served to AI/ML models across consulting use cases including CDD/FDD automation, value creation tracking, working capital optimization, restructuring scenario engines, portfolio benchmarking and MIS intelligence layers
* Drive the development of the firm’s proprietary financial and industry data assets including training data curation, golden datasets for model evaluation and benchmarking databases
* Design the firm’s knowledge graph strategy, capturing structured relationships between companies, deal comparables, management teams and operational KPIs to power next\-generation AI reasoning
* Oversee design and operation of scalable ELT/ETL pipelines ingesting structured and unstructured data from diverse sources including financial data providers (Capital IQ, Refinitiv, PitchBook, Bloomberg), client ERP/CRM systems, SEC filings, management packs and market research
* Own the analytics engineering layer powering consulting analytics including financial benchmarking, working capital KPI dashboards, EBITDA bridge models and cost structure analyses, and build reusable data product templates that let consulting teams rapidly spin up client\-specific analytics environments
* Lead and develop a team of two to three Vice Presidents and their Senior Associates (approximately 15 to 20 professionals) across data engineering, analytics engineering and data governance, providing strategic and technical direction, conducting structured performance reviews and owning career development
* Drive talent strategy for the Data Strategy \& Engineering function including hiring plans, role design, vendor partner selection and management, capability building, career ladders and compensation benchmarking in partnership with HR
* Drive the data governance framework including policies, standards, stewardship model and compliance controls for handling client deal data, portfolio company data and third\-party data, in alignment with NDA and regulatory obligations
* Oversee data security architecture in collaboration with the security function, with particular attention to AI training data handling, model output retention and deal data segregation
* Build and operate data quality programs including automated monitoring, anomaly detection and alerting to surface data issues before they affect AI model outputs or consulting deliverables
* Partner with the India Delivery Leader, the Director, AI Solutions and US\-based Practice Line Leaders to translate firm priorities into a sequenced data platform roadmap with measurable business outcomes, and report on platform\-level KPIs including adoption, data quality, freshness SLAs, productivity impact and ROI
* Identify and shape data monetization opportunities within the firm’s consulting practice including proprietary benchmarking databases, index products and data\-as\-a\-service offerings, and partner with firm leadership to commercialize proprietary data assets as consulting IP and competitive differentiators
* Serve as a thought leader on data strategy in deal advisory and portfolio management, engaging in senior client conversations on data room analytics, portfolio data standardization and data\-driven value creation, and representing the firm at internal forums and external industry events where appropriate
* Manage relationships with third\-party data providers, evaluate new data sources for relevance to consulting use cases and lead the evaluation and adoption of emerging data technologies including data mesh, federated query engines and AI\-native data platforms
* Contribute selectively as a hands\-on technical leader on flagship initiatives where senior architectural judgment is required
* Lead firm\-wide knowledge sharing, training and change management efforts to scale data and analytics capability across practice lines
* Support business development by shaping data\-related proposals, client presentations and solution demonstrations
* Support internal trainings and best practice sharing
* Contribute to a high\-performing, inclusive and values\-driven culture

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s of Technology / Engineering and / or Master's in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics or related technical field from a top undergraduate program; MBA with quantitative focus strongly preferred
* Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon
* Ability to collaborate across global time zones, including US\-based teams
* Ten to fifteen years of progressive experience in AI/ML, software engineering or related technical disciplines, with a meaningful portion of that experience in management consulting, professional services or private equity\-backed advisory environments
* Demonstrated experience leading AI or technology functions of 10 or more professionals, including managing managers and developing senior individual contributors
* Proven track record setting product or portfolio roadmaps for AI, data or software functions and translating ambiguous business priorities into sequenced delivery plans
* Track record building and scaling teams, including direct hiring leadership and experience managing vendor or offshore delivery partners
* Deep working knowledge of LLM\-powered applications, agentic AI architectures, automation workflows and the modern AI tooling ecosystem (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, LangChain, N8N, Zapier or similar)
* Proficiency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and the ability to engage credibly in technical reviews and architectural decisions
* Strong understanding of data engineering, model evaluation, MLOps and modern software development practices
* Demonstrated ability to establish and enforce responsible AI standards including bias detection, explainability and data privacy across production AI systems
* Experience operating in client\-facing or executive\-facing settings with the ability to shape AI\-related proposals, presentations and senior stakeholder conversations
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive\-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast\-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high\-pressure environments
* Ability to convey technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders

We advocate for advancing equity and inclusion to create more equitable workplaces and a better tomorrow.

 **JOB OVERVIEW**

  

This role is central to the support and evolution of the Canada Trade application (Nexus) and its associated reporting capabilities for the Canada Sales business.

 **As a D\&T Analyst II – Commercial Capabilities – Canada Trade,** you will work closely with the Sr. D\&T Analyst, Canada Sales, Sales Finance, and other business teams, as well as D\&T delivery teams. You will support the run, operate, and transform agenda for the Canada Trade (Nexus) ecosystem by:

* Understanding business processes and trade promotion use cases
* Translating them into clear functional requirements and user stories
* Supporting incident resolution and enhancements across the Nexus application and its data \& reporting layer

  

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, solid data and SQL capabilities, and the ability to work in a highly collaborative, agile environment. The individual should be able to work independently on defined workstreams and collaborate effectively with senior team members on larger enterprise initiatives. **KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

 **1****. Application Support \& Operations (Run \& Operate)**

* Serve as one of the primary D\&T contacts for day\-to\-day support, operation, and minor enhancements of the Canada Trade (Nexus) application.
* Triage and resolve application issues raised via Remedy within defined SLAs, including initial diagnosis, functional analysis, and coordination with technical teams until user confirmation and closure.
* Monitor the operational stability and data integrity of Nexus by:
* Reviewing system health dashboards (e.g., Datadog)
* Monitoring and validating scheduled jobs in Tidal
* Supporting regular checks and reconciliations across source and reporting layers
* Document incidents, root causes, and permanent fixes, contributing to a strong knowledge base for the team.
* Ensure all support and change activities follow SOX\-compliant processes and documentation standards.

 **2\. Requirements, Enhancements \& Delivery Support (Transform)**

* Partner with Canada Sales, Sales Finance, and Sr. D\&T Analyst to gather, clarify, and document business requirements for Nexus and related reporting solutions.
* Translate business needs into user stories, use cases, and functional specifications in ADO (Azure DevOps) or equivalent tools.
* Support the end\-to\-end enhancement lifecycle: requirement refinement, test case definition, UAT coordination, and deployment validation.
* Support data and reporting requirements by working with Data Engineers and BI Developers to ensure well\-defined, high\-quality data sets are available to downstream reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, BOBJ).
* Participate in design and review sessions, providing functional and data insights to help shape robust, scalable solutions.

 **3\. Data \& Reporting Consultation**

* Develop a strong understanding of Canada Trade domain processes (e.g., trade promotions, deductions, accruals, settlements) and related data flows across Nexus and downstream systems.
* Use SQL (SQL Server/BigQuery) to perform data analysis, root\-cause investigations, and validation of business logic in datasets and reports.
* Provide functional and basic technical consultation on data structures, metrics, and reporting logic to business stakeholders and D\&T partners.
* Contribute to data quality improvements by identifying recurring issues, proposing remediation steps, and supporting implementation.

 **4\. Collaboration, Ways of Working \& Documentation**

* Work in a cross\-functional agile team including D\&T Analysts, Data Engineers, BI Developers, and business stakeholders to deliver business value\-driven projects.
* Contribute to the creation and maintenance of:
* Business process and system documentation
* Functional specifications / user stories / scenarios
* Support runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge articles
* Provide clear and timely communication to stakeholders on issue status, risks, and progress of enhancements.
* Demonstrate strong team collaboration, sharing knowledge with peers and supporting onboarding of new team members.

 **5\. Continuous Improvement \& Professional Growth**

* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve system usability, and enhance data quality within the Canada Trade ecosystem.
* Participate in retrospectives and continuous improvement initiatives, sharing insights and suggestions.
* Build capabilities in cloud (GCP), data tools, and Nexus domain to grow toward higher ownership and complexity in the role.
 **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Education – Full time graduation from an accredited university (Mandatory\- Note: This is the minimum education criteria which cannot be altered)
* Education
	+ Minimum Degree Requirements: Bachelors
	+ Preferred Degree Requirements: Bachelors
	+ Preferred Major Area of Study: Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline
* Experience
	+ Minimum years of related experience required: 3\+ years in D\&T / IT / Analytics or similar roles
	+ Preferred years of related experience: 4\-6 years
	+ Experience as a Technical Business Analyst or D\&T Analyst: 3\+ years (requirements, functional design, issue analysis, testing support)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Strong data analysis and SQL skills (SQL Server or similar relational databases).
* Experience working with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into functional specifications or user stories.
* Exposure to trade / commercial / sales processes in any geography (e.g., trade promotions, discounts, pricing, claims) OR strong willingness and aptitude to learn this domain quickly.
* Experience supporting applications and/or data/reporting solutions, including incident analysis, testing, and user support.
* Good understanding of agile ways of working and familiarity with backlog tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira).
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to independently drive assigned work packages.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills; ability to work with both business and technical audiences.

 **Expert level** **Intermediate Level** **Basic Level*** Analyst Experience

* SQL Queries

* Tableau and BOBJ
* Agile Methodology
* Alation

 3\. **Litigation** **\& Regulatory Support**

 4**.Cross\-functional Collaboration**

**Preferred Skills \& Attributes**


* Deep understanding of global patent systems and procedures (including Indian, US, EP, and PCT).
* Demonstrated expertise in patent analysis, drafting, prosecution, and litigation support.
* Exposure to P\-IV litigations is highly desirable.
* Expertise in global IP law, with hands\-on experience in patent filing, prosecution, and infringement/invalidity analysis.
* Strong command over FTO analysis, Orange Book navigation, and regulatory IP alignment (including 505(b)(2\) applications).

**The Interview Process**


We want our interview process to feel clear, straightforward, and supportive. If your experience and expectations look like a strong match for the role, here’s what you can expect next:

* **Experience Interview** \- A more in\-depth interview (usually online) with the hiring manager to explore your skills, experience and approach, and how these align with the role, our principles, and our ways of working.

* Review the learning content to ensure technical accuracy, relevance, completeness, and alignment with latest UK pensions regulations.
* Offer insights and updates to support the continuous improvement of the learning material.

* **Confidence \& Preparation** : Thorough command over session content, with readiness to address learner questions independently.
* **Responsiveness \& Patience** : Addressing queries professionally while encouraging participation across knowledge levels.
* **Continuous Improvement Mindset:** Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset, seeking better ways to enhance learning and delivery.

**Required Skills and Experience**

**Must\-Have**

* 3–6 years of hands\-on experience in UK pensions administration or a closely related process.
* Comfort with virtual platforms (Teams/Zoom) and basic presentation tools (PPT, whiteboard tools).
* Strong organizational skills for managing batch\-wise logistics, learner data, and follow\-ups.
* High accountability for independent training delivery after initial support phase.
* Pensions Administration domain experience is a must.

**Good\-to\-Have**

* Exposure to CPC or APE content or certification (preferred but not mandatory).
* Experience coordinating or contributing to training content development.
* Familiarity with LMS tools or digital learning platforms.

**Who can apply?**

This role is not limited to colleagues who are already working in training or learning teams within pensions or benefits administration organisations.


We are equally open to experienced pensions administrators who are currently working in the business or operations side and are interested in pivoting into a training role and building a career in learning. What is non\-negotiable is **deep expertise in pensions administration, a strong understanding of the regulatory environment, pensions rules, and the ability to work through and explain complex calculation scenarios and cases** .

title: Trainee Research Associate
description:
**Trainee Research Associate**  **C0010(Freshers Only, Remote)**

**Research NXT / Bamboo Reports**

**Location:** Remote \| **Type:** Full\-time, Fresher \| **Compensation:** ₹2,40,000 – ₹2,60,000 per year

**About Research NXT and Bamboo Reports**

Research NXT is a 10\-year\-old research and intelligence company based in India. We help B2B technology companies understand their markets. When a software company wants to know which businesses to sell to, which decision\-makers to reach, and how their competitors are positioned, they come to us. Our analysts do the digging, structure the findings, and deliver intelligence that drives real business decisions.

Bamboo Reports is our flagship platform, built over three years by our own team. It is used by global technology vendors, consulting firms, and investors to plan their India strategy.

We are a small, analyst\-led team. Bootstrapped. Profitable since day one. In 2025, we rebuilt our entire platform using AI\-assisted development, and AI now runs across our research workflow. We are hiring our next batch of Research Associates who will learn the craft of intelligence work, and grow with us as we scale.

*Rated* ***4\.4 on Glassdoor*** *and* ***4\.1 on Google*** *by our current and former team members. Check for yourself before you apply.*

**Who We Are Looking For**

We want curious, sharp\-eyed freshers who love finding things on the internet. If you have ever gone down a Wikipedia rabbit hole for three hours, spent a weekend researching which laptop to buy, or pieced together information from LinkedIn, company websites, and news articles to understand a company, you might be our kind of person.

This role is about:

* Secondary research across the open web, company websites, LinkedIn, financial reports, and industry sources
* Reading between the lines of what companies say to find what they actually do
* Structuring messy information into clean, usable datasets
* Learning how to use AI tools to do research faster, sharper, and at scale

You will not write code. You will not build models. But you will work alongside AI every single day, because that is how modern research is done. The future of research belongs to analysts who know how to use AI well. We will teach you.

**Why This Role Is Different**

Most entry\-level research jobs have you filling spreadsheets all day. This one is different.

You will work on intelligence that real B2B companies pay for. Your work shows up in dashboards used by decision\-makers at technology vendors, consulting firms, and global enterprises. You will learn:

* How AI is changing the research profession, and how to stay ahead of it
* How to structure data like a product, not just a report
* How B2B companies use intelligence to make real decisions
* What good analytical thinking looks like, from analysts who have been doing this for two decades

**Where This Role Can Take You**

A Trainee Research Associate role at Research NXT is not a stop\-gap job. It is the start of a career in intelligence.

**Several of the people who joined us as Trainee Research Associates three to four years ago are today Managers leading platform development and research at Bamboo Reports.** They shape what gets built, how it gets built, and how we deliver intelligence to clients. That is the path we open for people who take the craft seriously.

If you are looking for a place where your work compounds, where you are trusted with real responsibility early, and where growing with the company is the norm rather than the exception, you will find it here.

**Apply Only If**

* You have your own laptop or PC at home with power backup
* You have a minimum 50 Mbps broadband connection and a quiet space to work
* You are comfortable reading and writing in English
* You know your way around MS Word, PowerPoint, and Excel
* You can search the internet like a detective, not just a casual user

**What You Get**

* Monthly performance incentives
* Work\-from\-home setup
* One\-month paid on\-the\-job training with a stipend
* Training completion bonus and certificate on successful completion
* Internet reimbursement
* Corporate health insurance
* Paid sick leave, paid time off, leave encashment
* Direct mentorship from the founder and senior analysts
* Real exposure to AI tools that working analysts use every day

**Selection Process**

**Round 1: System Check (10 minutes).** Shortlisted candidates receive an email with instructions to confirm their setup.

**Round 2: Research Assignment (1 day).** We give you a short basic training, followed by a data assignment. This tells us how you think, not just what you know.

**Round 3: Technical and Personal Interview.** A conversation about your assignment, your curiosity, and how you approach problems.

Selected candidates begin a one\-month paid on\-the\-job training.

**Application Questions**

* Do you have your own laptop or PC with reliable power backup?
* Do you have an internet connection with a speed of 50 Mbps or higher?
* How would you rate your proficiency in MS Excel? (Beginner / Intermediate / Advanced)
* In two or three sentences, tell us about one topic you researched on your own in the last six months, and what you found.

Pay: ₹240,000\.00 \- ₹260,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Work from home

description:
We are hiring a **QA Specialist (Medical Background)** to join our Clinical Quality Assurance function. This is a full\-time, ground\-floor role for a doctor who wants to step beyond patient consultations and shape how clinical quality is delivered at scale across 40\+ doctors and 400\+ new patients every day. You will be the safety net behind every prescription and the voice that drives doctor coaching, protocol refinement, and patient\-outcome improvements. Open to **MBBS, BAMS, BDS** or any equivalent medical qualification — freshers and experienced candidates both encouraged to apply.
  

**What You Will Do**  

* Audit prescriptions against the Internal Clinical Protocol (ICP): 100% of GLP\-1 prescriptions (Rybelsus, Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro) and a 30–50% random sample of Orlistat, Metformin, SGLT2i, and supplement prescriptions every day.
* Manage real\-time escalations from the health coach \+ sales WhatsApp group; log every issue in the escalation tracker within 30 minutes with severity (P0–P3\), patient ID, doctor name, and resolution status.
* Conduct random call audits on recorded 1st Doctor Consultations (10\+ per day) and score them on a 14\-point structure checklist covering RCA, blood markers, patient education, time management, and rapport.
* Maintain the Doctor QA Scorecard with 28 objective metrics across 6 categories — updated weekly, reviewed monthly, feeding GREEN / AMBER / RED doctor classifications.
* Run daily syncs with the Clinical Lead at 09:00 AM and 05:00 PM to review findings, align on doctor coaching, and prioritise the next day.
* Generate weekly QA reports with doctor rankings, error patterns, patient outcome snapshots, and actionable recommendations — plus identify systemic ICP gaps that need protocol updates

Postgraduate degree is a plus but not required.

description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a compassionate and dedicated Special Educator to join our multidisciplinary team. You will be responsible for providing individualized instruction and support to children with diverse learning needs, including Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), ADHD, and developmental delays. Your goal will be to create a nurturing environment that fosters academic, social, and emotional growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **IEP Development:** Design, implement, and regularly update Individualized Education Programs (IEPs) tailored to each student’s specific needs and goals.
* **Instructional Adaptation:** Modify the general curriculum and teaching materials to suit different learning styles and abilities.
* **Assessment:** Conduct initial and ongoing educational assessments to monitor student progress and adjust intervention strategies accordingly.
* **Behavior Management:** Use evidence\-based interventions and positive reinforcement to manage classroom behavior and emotional challenges.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with our Occupational Therapists, Speech Therapists, and parents to provide a holistic support system for the child.
* **Life Skills Training:** Teach basic academic, social, and functional life skills to encourage student independence.
* **Documentation:** Maintain accurate records of student attendance, progress reports, and behavioral data as per center protocols.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Special Education (B.Ed. or M.Ed. Special Education) is mandatory.
* **Certification:** **Must be registered with the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI).**
* **Experience:** 1–3 years of experience in a clinical or school setting. Freshers with internship backgrounds are welcome to apply.
* **Specialization:** Knowledge of various disabilities (ASD, ADHD, Dyslexia, Down Syndrome) and assistive teaching tools.
* **Communication:** Fluency in Malayalam and English to effectively communicate with students and parents.
* **Soft Skills:** High level of patience, empathy, adaptability, and a genuine passion for child development.

**Benefits**

* Professional development and training opportunities.
* Collaborative work environment with experienced therapists.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should submit their CV and RCI registration certificate through Indeed or email it to **openarmschilddevelopmentcenter@gmail.com**.

title: AutoCAD Draftsman/woman
description:
Ncore Builders is looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented Civil Draftsman to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for preparing accurate technical drawings and plans for construction and interior projects. Both freshers and experienced candidates are encouraged to apply.

**LOCATION : PAYYANNUR**

**Working Drawing Preparation:**

* Prepare detailed working drawings for the entire project, including plans, elevations, sections, and construction details.
* Ensure all drawings are dimensionally accurate, reflect the design intent, and meet project specifications.
* Review design documents for compliance with building codes, standards, and regulations.

**Detailed Section Drawings:**

* Produce detailed section drawings that represent vertical cut\-throughs of the building to illustrate internal construction, material layers, and structural details.
* Focus on areas requiring in\-depth analysis, such as foundations, walls, floors, and roof connections.

**Detailed Elevation Drawings:**

* Prepare clear, scaled elevation drawings of all building facades, showing exterior details such as windows, doors, and architectural features.
* Specify materials, finishes, and surface treatments for the building’s exterior elements.

**Electrical Detailing:**

* Create detailed electrical drawings, including the layout of circuits, outlets, lighting fixtures, panel locations, and wiring connections.
* Work closely with electrical engineers to ensure the electrical system is properly integrated into the building design.

**Plumbing Detailing:**

* Develop plumbing drawings that include the layout of pipes, drains, water supply, fixtures, and valves.
* Provide details on plumbing connections, materials, and specifications to ensure the system meets code requirements and is operational.

**Tiles Laying Detailing:**

* Create detailed drawings for tile layouts in bathrooms, kitchens, floors, and other areas.
* Specify tile types, grout lines, installation patterns, and material finishes.
* Coordinate with contractors to ensure proper tile installation procedures are followed.

**Landscape Detailing:**

* Prepare detailed landscaping drawings that include plant layouts, irrigation systems, pathways, and outdoor structures.
* Detail features like lighting, fencing, and surface materials, ensuring they align with the overall architectural design.

**Compound Wall Detailing:**

* Provide drawings detailing the design and construction of compound walls, including foundation, material selection, and structural components.
* Ensure wall details are in compliance with safety standards and functional requirements.

**Structural Detailing:**

* Develop structural drawings that detail the design and construction of elements such as foundations, beams, columns, slabs, and other load\-bearing components.
* Coordinate with structural engineers to ensure structural integrity and compliance with building codes.

**Joinery Detailing:**

* Prepare detailed joinery drawings for custom woodwork, cabinetry, doors, windows, and other wooden elements.
* Specify material types, finishes, dimensions, and hardware for precise fabrication and installation.

**Set Out Detailing:**

* Develop set\-out drawings that show the exact placement of key structural elements, foundations, walls, columns, and other critical components on the construction site.
* Ensure accurate alignment and positioning according to the architectural design.

**Set Out Plan Preparation:**

* Create set\-out plans that provide clear instructions on the layout of the building on the site, ensuring that all measurements are precise and aligned with the design documents.
* Coordinate with site surveyors and construction teams for accurate implementation.

**Truss Work Detailing:**

* Provide detailed drawings for roof trusses, including dimensions, material specifications, and connection details.
* Collaborate with structural engineers to ensure the trusses meet safety and load requirements.

**Requirements :**

* Proficiency in AutoCAD and other drafting software
* Basic knowledge of construction methods and materials
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Good communication and teamwork skills
* Diploma or degree in civil engineering, drafting, or related field.

**Experience**

* 1\-2 years of experience in civil drafting (preferred)
* Experience in infrastructure, roadworks, drainage, or land development projects is an advantage Working Conditions
* Office\-based role with occasional site visits
* May require coordination with site supervisor and project manager

description:

Job Title: Junior Full Stack Developer (MERN)**Job Overview**

We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented **Junior MERN Stack Developer** to join our growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining full\-stack applications while working closely with senior developers and designers. This is a perfect opportunity for a fresher or someone with up to 1 year of experience to gain hands\-on production experience in a collaborative environment.

title: Clinical Business Analyst - US Healthcare
description:
**Job Title: Business Analyst (Clinical \- U.S Healthcare)** 




**Exp :5 – 9 Years** 




**Notice Period :Imm – 30 Days** 




**Interview:Face to Face** 




  





**Position Overview:** 




 The EMR Business Analyst plays a critical role in bridging the gap between healthcare operations and technology solutions. This position is responsible for analyzing, documenting, and managing business processes related to Electronic Medical Records (EMR) systems. The EMR BA collaborates with stakeholders, including healthcare providers, IT professionals, and administrative staff, to ensure the effective implementation and optimization of EMR systems.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 Elicit and document business requirements from key stakeholders to understand their needs related to EMR functionalities.
 



 Analyze and translate business requirements into technical specifications for EMR system enhancements and implementations.
 



 Conduct thorough analysis of existing business processes related to EMR usage and identify areas for improvement.
 



 Recommend and implement process enhancements to optimize the use of EMR systems and improve overall efficiency.
 



 Collaborate with IT teams to ensure successful implementation and integration of EMR systems.
 



 Coordinate with vendors and internal teams to configure, customize, and deploy EMR solutions according to business requirements.
 



 Work closely with data analysts to ensure the accuracy, integrity, and security of EMR data.
 



 Develop and maintain data mapping and data transformation processes for EMR\-related data.
 



 Develop training materials and provide training sessions for end\-users on EMR system functionalities.
 



 Provide ongoing support to users, troubleshoot issues, and address user concerns related to EMR usage.
 



 Develop and execute test plans to ensure the quality and reliability of EMR system implementations.
 



 Collaborate with testing teams to identify and resolve issues during the testing phase.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




 A bachelor's degree in healthcare management, health informatics, business administration, or a related field. Additional certifications in healthcare compliance or informatics are beneficial.
 



 In\-depth understanding of Meaningful Use requirements, CMS regulations, and other healthcare compliance initiatives. Familiarity with EHR systems and health information exchange (HIE) standards.
 



 Proficient in data analysis, reporting, and interpretation. Ability to use analytical software and tools effectively.
 



 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex regulatory concepts to non\-technical stakeholders clearly.
 



 Proven ability to identify compliance\-related challenges and develop effective solutions.
 



 Demonstrated ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders effectively.
 



 Strong focus on accuracy and precision in compliance analysis and documentation.
 



 Ability to adapt to changing regulatory requirements and healthcare industry trends.

\#\# Job Description: Head of Operations

\*\*Location:\*\* Sujay’s Dental Care

\*\*Reports to:\*\* CEO / Clinical Director

\#\#\# \*\*Role Purpose\*\*

As the \*\*Head of Operations\*\*, you will be the backbone of Sujay’s Dental Care. Your mission is to bridge the gap between clinical excellence and business efficiency. You will design, implement, and oversee the systems that ensure every patient receives world\-class care while driving the clinic's growth through strategic marketing and rigorous operational management.

\#\#\# \*\*Key Responsibilities\*\*

\#\#\#\# \*\*1\. Marketing \& Lead Generation\*\*

You are responsible for keeping the patient pipeline full by integrating traditional and digital strategies.

\* \*\*BTL Activities:\*\* Plan and execute Below\-the\-Line activities, including local community camps, corporate tie\-ups, and dental awareness workshops.

\* \*\*Digital Oversight:\*\* Manage and optimize digital marketing campaigns (Social Media, Google Ads, SEO) in collaboration with agencies or internal teams to ensure a high ROI on lead generation.

\* \*\*Brand Presence:\*\* Ensure the clinic’s brand voice is consistent across all offline and online touchpoints.

\#\#\#\# \*\*2\. End\-to\-End Operational Excellence\*\*

You will build the "Sujay’s Dental Care Standard" by setting up and auditing SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) for:

\* \*\*Front Desk \& Reception:\*\* Streamlining patient check\-ins, appointment scheduling, and the "first impression" experience.

\* \*\*Patient Care Coordinators:\*\* Enhancing the patient journey from inquiry to post\-treatment follow\-up.

\* \*\*Consultation \& Sales:\*\* Training doctors and consultants on ethical sales techniques to improve case acceptance rates.

\* \*\*Clinical Quality Control:\*\* Monitoring the quality of treatments provided by associate doctors to maintain high medical standards.

\* \*\*Billing \& Finance:\*\* Overseeing the entire billing lifecycle, ensuring transparency, accuracy, and efficient revenue collection.

\#\#\#\# \*\*3\. Facility \& Asset Management\*\*

Ensure the clinic is always "audit\-ready" and fully equipped.

\* \*\*Inventory Control:\*\* Implementing a robust inventory management system to prevent stock\-outs or wastage of dental consumables.

\* \*\*Asset Management:\*\* Scheduling preventive maintenance for high\-end dental equipment (Chairs, X\-rays, Autoclaves) to minimize downtime.

\* \*\*Infrastructure:\*\* Managing the general upkeep, hygiene, and aesthetics of the facility.

\#\#\#\# \*\*4\. HR \& Performance Management\*\*

You will lead the team that powers the clinic.

\* \*\*Staffing:\*\* Managing the recruitment and onboarding of non\-clinical and support staff.

\* \*\*KPI Tracking:\*\* Setting clear performance benchmarks for all departments (Reception, Nursing, Doctors).

\* \*\*Appraisals:\*\* Conducting regular performance reviews and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

\* \*\*Training:\*\* Organizing soft skills and process training for the staff to ensure seamless service delivery.

\#\#\# \*\*Candidate Requirements\*\*

\* \*\*Experience:\*\* 8–12 years in Operations Management, preferably within the healthcare, hospitality, or retail sectors. Experience in a dental chain is a significant plus.

\* \*\*Education:\*\* MBA or Master’s in Healthcare Administration/Hospital Management.

\* \*\*Skills:\*\* \* Strong grasp of \*\*unit economics\*\* and P\&L management.

\* Proven track record in \*\*lead generation\*\* and marketing coordination.

\* Exceptional leadership and \*\*conflict resolution\*\* skills.

\* Data\-driven mindset with proficiency in clinic management software.

\#\#\# \*\*Why Join Sujay’s Dental Care?\*\*

This is a high\-impact leadership role where you won't just manage a clinic—you will build the systems that allow us to scale. We offer a dynamic environment where clinical integrity meets modern business strategy.

description:
**Job Description — HR Manager (Tutor Recruitment)** 




**Company:** 
 Toronto French Academy (TFA)
 



**Role:** 
 HR Manager — French Tutor Recruitment
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (India\-based)
 



**Compensation: INR** 
 60K \- 1\.2L Per month
 



**Employment type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 3–5 years
 



**Reports to:** 
 Founder / Director
 



**Team:** 
 Works directly with founder and operations
 



  





**About Toronto French Academy** 




 Toronto French Academy (TFA) is a Canadian online French\-language school that prepares adult learners for the
 **TEF** 
 (
 *Test d'évaluation de français* 
 ) and
 **TCF** 
 (
 *Test de connaissance du français* 
 ) examinations — the two most widely used French proficiency tests for Canadian immigration, academic admission, and professional certification.
 



 We deliver live, synchronous French classes over Google Meet and Zoom through a distributed team of certified French tutors based in India. Our students are adults, mostly Canada\-bound, and they rely on us to get them to a specific score on a specific test by a specific date. That means the quality of our tutors is the single most important lever in our business — and that is precisely what this role exists to protect.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 TFA is growing, and so is our need for consistently high\-quality French tutors. Today, tutor recruitment sits with the founder, which is neither scalable nor sustainable. We're hiring a dedicated
 **HR Manager** 
 whose sole and focused mandate is to own
 **end\-to\-end recruitment of French tutors** 
 — from sourcing and outreach right through to negotiation, offer, and onboarding handoff.
 



 This is
 **not** 
 a generalist HR role. You will not be handling payroll, policy, employee relations, or back\-office HR admin. You will live and breathe one thing:
 **finding, evaluating, and closing excellent French tutors for TFA.** 




  





**What you will own** 




 1\. Sourcing \& pipeline building
 


* Build and continuously refresh a pipeline of DELF/DALF\-certified French tutors (B2, C1, C2 levels) based in India.
* Identify and tap into the right channels: LinkedIn, language\-teacher communities, Alliance Française networks, Naukri, Indeed, Apna, university French departments, Telegram/WhatsApp tutor groups, referrals, and niche job boards.
* Run proactive outbound outreach — cold messages, referral campaigns, and targeted posts — not just inbound applications.
* Maintain a clean, organized applicant tracking system (ATS or structured spreadsheet/Notion) with candidate stage, notes, and follow\-ups.



 2\. Screening \& evaluation
 


* Review resumes and credentials; verify DELF / DALF / equivalent certifications.
* Conduct first\-round screening calls to assess communication, professionalism, availability, and cultural fit with TFA.
* Coordinate and administer TFA's tutor evaluation process — demo classes, written/spoken French assessments, and subject\-matter interviews (you do not need to evaluate French proficiency yourself; you coordinate it with TFA's academic evaluator).
* Filter hard so the founder only meets serious, qualified finalists.



 3\. Interview coordination
 


* Schedule and run structured interview loops.
* Collect standardized feedback from every interviewer.
* Keep candidates warm, informed, and moving — no ghosting, no bottlenecks.



 4\. Negotiation \& closing
 


* Present offers in line with TFA's compensation framework.
* Handle negotiation on per\-hour rates, working hours, and availability commitments.
* Close candidates — including reading the room and knowing when to push and when to walk away.
* Handle counter\-offers and competing offers professionally.



 5\. Contracting \& onboarding handoff
 


* Issue the TFA Independent Contractor Agreement, collect signatures and required documents (government ID, certification proofs, bank details).
* Run the administrative portion of onboarding: access, tooling, introductions.
* Hand off cleanly to the academic / operations team for teaching onboarding.



 6\. Recruitment ops \& reporting
 


* Own recruitment metrics: pipeline volume, time\-to\-hire, source effectiveness, offer\-accept rate, early\-tenure drop\-off.
* Report weekly to the founder on pipeline health and hiring velocity.
* Continuously improve JDs, screening rubrics, interview scorecards, and outreach templates based on what's working.



  





**What you are
 *not* 
 responsible for** 




 To keep this role sharp and focused, you will
 **not** 
 own:
 


* General HR operations, payroll, or statutory compliance.
* Employee relations, performance management, or grievances for existing tutors.
* Tutor training, academic supervision, or pedagogical evaluation.
* Recruitment for non\-tutor roles (unless specifically asked).
* Student\-facing or sales work.



 Your success is measured by one thing:
 **a consistently full, high\-quality tutor pipeline and clean, fast, fair hiring.** 




  





**Who you are** 




 Must\-haves
 


* **3–5 years of end\-to\-end recruitment experience** 
 , ideally in a high\-volume or specialized\-talent environment (EdTech, BPO, tutoring platforms, language services, or agency recruitment is a strong plus).
* Proven track record of
 **owning hiring loops from sourcing to offer acceptance** 
 — not just coordinating.
* Comfortable with
 **outbound sourcing on LinkedIn and other channels** 
 — you don't wait for applications to land; you go find people.
* Strong
 **written and spoken English** 
 — you'll be representing TFA to candidates and communicating daily with the Canadian founder.
* Sharp judgment on people: you can tell the difference between a polished resume and a person who will actually show up, teach well, and stay.
* Organized and systematic — pipeline hygiene, follow\-ups, and data tracking are second nature to you.
* **Comfortable working India hours with meaningful overlap with Toronto time** 
 (typically early mornings or evenings India time for founder syncs and North American candidate conversations where needed).



  





**Nice\-to\-haves** 



* Experience hiring
 **teachers, tutors, trainers, or subject\-matter experts** 
 — especially language tutors.
* Familiarity with DELF / DALF / CEFR or similar language\-proficiency frameworks.
* Working knowledge of French (not required, but helpful).
* Experience using ATS tools (Workable, Recruitee, Zoho Recruit, Greenhouse, Lever) or building lightweight tracking systems in Notion / Airtable / Google Sheets.
* Exposure to the Indian freelance / independent contractor talent market.



  





**How you work** 



* Ownership\-first: you treat this pipeline like your own business.
* Bias to action: fewer meetings, more closes.
* Direct communicator: clear updates, clear blockers, clear asks.
* Comfortable being the
 **only HR person** 
 — this is a standalone role, not a team to inherit.



  





**What we offer** 



* A focused, well\-defined mandate with clear success metrics.
* Direct access to the founder — no layers, no politics.
* Fully remote work from anywhere in India.
* Competitive compensation commensurate with experience (to be discussed during the process).
* The satisfaction of building the team that directly moves the needle on students' lives — every TEF/TCF pass we enable is someone's path to Canada.



  





**Hiring process** 



1. **Application review** 
 — resume \+ a short note on a tough recruiting challenge you solved.
2. **Screening call (30 min)** 
 with the founder.
3. **Case exercise** 
 — we'll ask you to source and shortlist 5 DELF C1 tutor candidates in India using publicly available channels, and walk us through your approach.
4. **Deep\-dive interview (60 min)** 
 — recruitment process, negotiation scenarios, judgment calls.
5. **Reference checks.**
6. **Offer.**



  





 We aim to complete the process within
 **2–3 weeks** 
 from first call.
 



  





**How to apply** 




 Send your resume and a short cover note to
 **info@frenchwithtfa.com** 
 with the subject line
 **"HR Manager — Tutor Recruitment"** 
 .
 



  





 In your note, please tell us:
 


1. A role you recently hired for end\-to\-end, and how you sourced the winning candidate.
2. What you'd do in your first 30 days at TFA.



  





 We read every application. We respond to shortlisted candidates within 5 business days.
 



*Toronto French Academy is an equal\-opportunity workplace. We evaluate candidates purely on the merits of their skills, experience, and judgment.*

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically proficient Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) to join our dynamic team specializing in the development and deployment of advanced rail signaling systems for Metro, Regional Rapid Transit Systems (RRTS), and European Train Control System (ETCS) projects. This role is ideal for a recent engineering graduate passionate about contributing to cutting\-edge rail infrastructure. The GET will play a pivotal role in the integration, testing, and commissioning of Communication\-Based Train Control (CBTC) and ETCS systems—critical components that ensure the safety, efficiency, and reliability of modern high\-speed rail networks. As a key member of the technical team, you will gain hands\-on experience in system architecture, interface coordination, and real\-time performance validation, while working closely with multidisciplinary teams across design, implementation, and operational phases. This position offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of India’s transformation in smart and sustainable urban mobility. **Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with design engineers, system integrators, and vendors to resolve technical issues during system integration.
* Conduct on\-site commissioning activities, including configuration, calibration, and troubleshooting of signaling equipment.
* Monitor system performance during trial runs and assist in root cause analysis of anomalies.
* Maintain detailed records of test results, deviations, and corrective actions in compliance with project QA/QC protocols.

* Attend technical meetings, site walkthroughs, and coordination sessions with stakeholders.

 **Requirements:**

* Strong foundational knowledge of CBTC and ETCS signaling principles, architecture, and interoperability.

* Ability to work in fast\-paced, project\-driven environments with attention to detail and adherence to safety protocols.

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Certification or training in railway signaling (e.g., from Indian Railways, ERTMS/ETCS, or accredited institutions) is a plus.
